intent: Implemented a 5-sensor array evenly spaced across the front to maximize tape coverage and sensing resolution. Chose moderate sensor size and balanced body dimensions for stability and maneuverability. Expect improved line detection and fewer line loss events, enabling the integrator to develop a more effective controller.
rationale: Starting with a balanced and robust sensor layout to maximize line detection and control precision. Chose 5 sensors spaced evenly across the front of the robot to cover the tape width well, with a sensor size of 0.012 m to balance resolution and coverage. Set wheel track and body width to 0.14 m to allow stable turning and off-track tolerance. Wheel radius at 0.035 m for a good balance of speed and torque. Body length at 0.18 m and mass at 0.8 kg to keep the robot agile yet stable. Intent is to provide the integrator a geometry that offers good line sensing and stable dynamics, expecting improved line following and fewer line loss events. Feedback requested includes completion, progress, line loss events, rms error, and max error to evaluate line tracking and stability.
